objections.claim: The spec justifies leaving `fan-out.mjs` and `build-judge-evidence.js` timeout-free with "with this fix a served child exits promptly, and an unserved one exits at its own deadline." That is not true for `build-judge-evidence.js`: its `dispatchOne` invokes `review-call.mjs` with `--system/--diff/--context/--expect/--backends-json` and **neither `--deadline` nor `--timeout`**. With no `totalDeadlineMs` there is no slice race, so no element signal is ever aborted by the chain; a trickling unserved backend resets `realStream`'s inactivity timeout on every keepalive byte, the element never settles, `runReviewChain` never returns, and the child hangs indefinitely — exactly as before this fix. The per-element abort only fires on a slice win or on settle; neither happens. The same gap applies to any `fan-out.mjs` lens dispatch that does not pass `--deadline` (not verifiable from the supplied context, but the build-judge half is).
objections.evidence: OUT OF SCOPE bullet "Timeouts or process-group kills in `fan-out.mjs` and `build-judge-evidence.js`" ("an unserved one exits at its own deadline"; "benefit automatically"), against the supplied `build-judge-evidence.js` `dispatchOne` (`runReviewCall(["--system", PHASE1_PROMPT, "--diff", diffFile, "--context", reconContextFile, "--expect", "contract", ...backendsArgs])` — no `--deadline`, no `--timeout`), and the spec's own holder analysis (the inactivity timeout "is a socket inactivity timeout reset by every chunk").
objections.predicted_consequence: a trickling judge/refuter backend stalls the build-review would-be-park loop indefinitely (pre-existing, unchanged by this ticket), while the spec's scope record asserts the class is closed — a future reader trusting "callers need no timeout" skips the follow-up the spec's own failure-modes section would otherwise trigger.
objections.disposition_rationale: Fixed in place: the out-of-scope line, reference table and Other-callers rationale now state that build-judge-evidence.js passes no --deadline and stays exposed; tracked as FAFF-1244 (blocked by FAFF-1239). Added unit DONE items for preflight abort, listener removal, getFn arity and the catch-path backstop wiring from the QA observations.
